LESSON: PRE-READING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 2.1: Pre-reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Pre-reading. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when you are reading?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate appropriate posture in preparation for reading,
2. learner applies word identification techniques while reading, 252
3. appreciate the importance of positioning materials appropriately while reading. modeled. at posters, pictures, drawings where reading is taking place and then respond to questions from the teacher and peers.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. demonstrate appropriate posture in preparation for reading,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate appropriate posture in preparation for reading,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. learner applies word identification techniques while reading, 252
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to learner applies word identification techniques while reading, 252. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the importance of positioning materials appropriately while reading. modeled. at posters, pictures, drawings where reading is taking place and then respond to questions from the teacher and peers.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of positioning materials appropriately while reading. modeled. at posters, pictures, drawings where reading is taking place and then respond to questions from the teacher and peers. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Pre-reading.
2. Explain Pre-reading to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Pre-reading.
4. Show that you can: demonstrate appropriate posture in preparation for reading,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Pre-reading. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when you are reading?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. demonstrate appropriate posture in preparation for reading,
2. learner applies word identification techniques while reading, 252
3. appreciate the importance of positioning materials appropriately while reading. modeled. at posters, pictures, drawings where reading is taking place and then respond to questions from the teacher and peers.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
